'''Diatia Major''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Southern Core]]'s<ref name="Southern Core" /> [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Diatia Major system/Legends|same name]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Lying on the edge of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region, the star was not [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by any [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

However, Diatia Major was encircled by the [[Diatian Clockwork]], a large, mysterious ring composed of a metallic alloy and etched with deep, regularly-spaced grooves. For [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], the ring amazed visitors, and it was widely believed to be constructed by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> who had disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[30,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Diatia Major was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the sidebar that would have mentioned the star was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding Diatia Major was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Diatia Major system in grid square L-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
